minutes_text:
CITY  OF SOUTH  GATE
  REGULAR  CITY  COUNCIL  MEETING
  MINUTES
  TUESDAY,  NOVEMBER  12, 2024

CALL  TO ORDER  Gil Hurtado,  Mayor  called  a Regular  City  Council  Meeting  to order  at
  6:48 p.m.

INVOCATION  Pastor Nick  Garife,  Gateway  Assembly

PLEDGE  OFALLEGIANCE  Nellie  Ruiz,  Deputy  Director  of Human  Resources

ROLL  CALL  Yodit  Glaze,  City  Clerk

PRESENT  Mayor  Gil Hurtado,  Vice Mayor  Maria  Davila,  Council  Member  Maria  del
  Pilar Avalos,  Council  Member  Joshua Barron  and Council  Member  Al
  Rios;  City  Treasurer  Jose De La Paz, City  Manager  Rob Houston,  City
  Attorney  Raul F. Salinas

COMMENTS  FROM  THE
AUDIENCE  - NON-AGENDA

ITEMS  Mario  Dominguez,  Resident  is upset at the result  of the recent  elections.

  Ruben  Pichardo,  Resident  is reporting  issues regarding  employee  Johanna
  making  up violation  codes to harass me since August  1, 2024.  Requesting
  assistance  to correct  this issue.

  Armando  Velasquez,  Kiwanis  announces  the Clean-up  and brunch  event at
  CasaAbuelita.  Bingo  Lottery  Night.  Food and Gift  Card Drive.

  Armando  Velasquez,  Resident  is not happy  that this year's  election  process
  did not include  Q&A's,  and independent  interviews.

  Ana,  Chamber  of Commerce  announces  future  events  for November  and
  December.

  Council  MemberAvalos  asked if parking  will  be allowed  on the Northside
  of SouthernAvenue  during  the Christmas  Parade.

  Darren  Arakawa,  Police  Chief  states that parking  will  not be allowed
  during  the parade.

EMAILS:  Yodit  Glaze,  City  Clerk  explains  that emails  that received  to be read at
  council  meetings  are summarized.  If anyone  is interested  in having  their
  full  comments  heard  are welcomed  to attend  city council  meetings  in
  person.
   REGULAR  CITY  COUNCIL  MEETING  MINUTES  OF NOVEMBER  12, 2024

  Amy  Lu, Leeland  Weave  Library  shares upcoming  events  at our local
EMAILS:
  libraries.

  Victor,  Resident  expresses  issues with  City  Clerk  actions  within  this recent

  election  process.

  Joseph Velasco  requests  an expedited  permit  review  process  for the

  Dominoes  expansion.

REPORTS  AND  COMMENTS

FROMCITYOFFICIALS  ArturoCervantes,DirectorofPublicWorksprovidesaCIPProject
  construction,  renovation  and resurfacing  updates.

  Steve Costley,  Director  of Parks & Recreation  thanks  residents  and

  community  for their  attendance  during  Halloween  Night  & Special
  Olympics  events.

  Meredith  Elguira,  Director  of Community  Development  responds  to Mr.

  Pichardo's  comments.  Currently,  looking  into his allegations.  Also,
  looking  into expediting  the process  for the Dominoe's  expansion.

  Wendy  O'Kelly,  Director  ofAdministrative  Services  provides  update  that

  staff is currently  working  on the Annual  Comprehensive  Financial  Report.

  Nelly  Cobos,  Deputy  Director  of Human  Resources  urges the public  to go

  to our city's  website  for job opportunities.

  Darren  Arakawa,  Police  Chief  thanks  community  and council  for their
  attendance  at the Family  Day at the Park. Received  great feedback.

  Rob Houston,  City  Manager  was able to participate  in the Halloween,
  Veterans  Day, and Family  Day at the Park events  and appreciates  the
  community  participation.

  Raul F. Salinas,  City Attorney  has nothing  to report.

  Jose De La Paz, City  Treasurer  has nothing  to report.

  Yodit  Glaze,  City  Clerk  has nothing  to report.

  Council  Member  Avalos  thanks  the community  for their  participation  in

  this year's  elections.  Attended  Family  Day at the Park. Appreciated  the

  hard work  of the Police  Dept. during  the Trunk  or Treat event.

   REGULAR  CITY  COUNCIL  MEETING  MINUTES  OF NOVEMBER  12, 2024

REPORTS  AND  COMMENTS
FROM  CITY  OFFICIALS

CONT'D  Council  Member  Rios congratulations  council  members  for this election
  and those who participated.  Attended  Family  Day at the Park and enjoyed
  seeing  all who attended.  Thank  you, Veterans  and their families.

  Would  like to ask the Chief  about the new administration  and worries
  regarding  our immigrant  community.

  Darren  Arakawa,  Chief  of Police  states that we do not enforce  immigration
  laws. Not our jurisdiction.  We do not ask immigration  status. We will
  arrest those that commit  crimes  in our  cornrnunity.

  Council  Member  Barron  honored  to attend the Veteran's  Day event.
  Attended  Family  Day at the Park. Thank  you to the organizations  that
  participated  in our events.  Looking  forward  to Breakfast  with  Santa.

  Vice Mayor  Davila  announces  the Power  Gateway  $8,000  rebate meetings
  November  16, 2024,  and November  19, 2024. Thank  you to Steve Costley
  and his staff for amazing  events.  Thank  you to detective  Sarah Medrano
  and Tony Mendez  on the Fentanyl  Presentation  for South  Gate Middle
  School  parents.

  Mayor  Gil Hurtado  attended  meeting  with  elected  officials  regarding
  issues with  broadband.

  Thank  you to our South  Gate employees  for making  sure our events  are
  safe for our community.

  Responds  to Mr. Pichardo's  comments.  I try my best to bring  back
  anyone's  issues to our staff. We strive  to do everything  we can to assist our
  cornrnunity.

  Elections  are stressful  but we offer  our commitment  to our community.  We
  might  have differences,  but we will  respect  the vote of the people.

DEVIATE  FROM

THE  AGENDA  At this time,  there being  no objections,  Mayor  Hurtado  stated that item 11
  would  be considered  out of its regular  agenda  order.
